Supply every metric; never guess. v2: AV Access Vector, AC Access Complexity, Au Authentication, C/I/A Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability. v3: AV Attack Vector, AC Attack Complexity, PR Privileges Required, UI User Interaction, S Scope,
